official_aggregation.rule: For each target file, average the four uncalibrated class scores across its 15 frozen windows, then take argmax in fixed OR/IR/B/N order.
official_aggregation.tie_rule: fixed class order OR,IR,B,N only if exact numerical tie remains after averaging

random_resampling.purpose: test file-label robustness to window composition while using the same frozen STEP09 classifier

reasonable_aggregations: majority of window argmax labels; exact vote ties broken by official mean scores among tied classes

hyperparameter_sensitivity.note: sensitivity analysis only; no retuning or reselection

stability_checks.cross_setting_vote_grid: 3 alpha values x 3 aggregation rules = 9 label votes per target file

uncertainty_rule.source_reference_population: correct source OOF independent files from STEP07 H1_RF
uncertainty_rule.score_evidence: flag if top score < source-correct q10 OR margin < source-correct q10 OR normalized entropy > source-correct q90
uncertainty_rule.window_stability_evidence: flag if official window-file agreement <0.80 OR 9-setting vote agreement <0.80 OR bootstrap agreement <0.90
uncertainty_rule.mechanism_evidence: flag if mechanism-feature nearest source prototype differs from final prediction OR predicted-class mechanism distance exceeds that source class p95 radius
uncertainty_rule.low_confidence: at least 2 of {score, window/stability, mechanism} evidence categories flagged
uncertainty_rule.probability_wording: all RF outputs are uncalibrated model scores, never true correctness probabilities

mechanism_evidence.method: source-class prototype distance on source-standardized, geometry-free mechanism proxy features
mechanism_evidence.role: explanatory side evidence only; not target truth

visualization.method: PCA fitted once on source independent-file mean 26-D standardized features
visualization.warning: clustering/separation is descriptive and does not prove target correctness

prohibited: calling uncalibrated scores probabilities/confidence of correctness
